text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Mejiro Bright has a
number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting all this time,
Trainer. I
know I took quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But the preparations are finally
complete. It's now
time for our hot
spring vacation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With those words, I recall us winning the
hot
spring ticket back at the raffle. But
what really
has my attention is
something different.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I had to find cute towels and have new
clothes
made for my dolls Maki and Kyu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Also, there was an even more
time-consuming
task.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I had to secure enough victories so that
I, as an
Umamusume of the Mejiro
family, could finally
relax without shame.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As laid-back as Mejiro Bright can be, it
seems she
took her win record into
account before
scheduling this trip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah... ♪ Traaainer... The waaater was
sooo
peeerfect...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear. I'm sorry. A long bath makes
even my
speaking loose and at ease.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs are quite remarkable. Not
only does
my body feel relaxed, but my
heart as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, this has been a
comforting
dream of mine for quite a
while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, being the owner of
a hot
spring inn used to be my future
ambition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's unexpected... I struggle to wrap
my mind
around the idea of a Mejiro
becoming the
proprietor of a hot spring
inn.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's true, Trainer. And now is actually the
perfect
opportunity for me to play the
part.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That makes you my guest, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Mejiro Bright fully assumes
the air of
an inn owner.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the House of Brilliance.
Please, come
inside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
First, through this window, you can enjoy
our
delightful garden. Oh my, would you
look at that
flower?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it's about to bloom, though
that
doesn't happen in an instant.
However, if you stay
and watch
patiently, eventually you'll see its full

transformation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I would give it two to maybe three days.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right. You'll be all packed up
and gone
by then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: In that case, let me show you the baths.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This is the pride of our establishment,
the
Sole-Restoring Waters. Go ahead,
step in...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Please, give your legs a good rest. May
the water
return their strength if even
only just a second
faster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's something a bit unconventional
about this
tour. Wait a second...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is. There are many Umamusume who
suffer an
injury and must rest for quite
some time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I know how difficult it is for them, being
unable to
run as they wish. Over time,
their insecurities pile
up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But if they could relax in the waters of a
hot
spring... I think it would not only
heal their
wounds, it would help light a
spark back into their
hearts as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Surely... that is also the duty of a Mejiro,
is it not?
To support all Umamusume in
the long term.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So, her dream of being the owner of a
hot spring
inn isn't just an idle fantasy, it
emerged as part of
her responsibilities as
a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The light from Mejiro Bright... will reach
far into
the future of the Umamusume
world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how was I? Do I make a good

proprietress?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Hearing you say that is quite the
boost to
my confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to start our inn together
when the time
comes. Trainer, you can
handle the business side!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She naturally assumes I'm on board, but I
can't
say I mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Teehee, I knew I
could
count on you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Why wouldn't I want to help with such a

wonderful idea? I think we can
accomplish this
splendid dream of hers
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Mejiro Bright and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
